UK Prime Minister Unveils Defence Investment Plan Amid Delays

UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced a significant defence investment plan, reportedly worth billions of pounds, aimed at boosting capabilities in areas like drone warfare and autonomous systems. The plan, which has faced delays, has drawn criticism from some political opponents. Funding for the initiative is expected to be drawn from various government projects.
